en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a cobblestone street running alongside a river with rapids and a low weir. An iron railing separates the sidewalk from the water. On the right side stand two‑storey wooden and stone houses with pitched roofs; a few pedestrians and a woman with a baby carriage are visible. Bare trees and larger buildings appear in the background. Red printed text at the top left reads "Ågatan med forsen, Upsala."
